WITH site_level AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(sp.memusagegb) as avg_ram,
    AVG(CASE WHEN sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu > 0 
             THEN CAST(sp.procgpu AS REAL) / sp.proccpu 
             ELSE NULL 
        END) as avg_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sp.memusagegb > 60.8
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat
)
SELECT 
  entrystat,
  AVG(avg_ram) as final_avg_ram,
  AVG(avg_ratio) as final_avg_ratio
FROM site_level
GROUP BY entrystat
ORDER BY entrystat
